scope: Owned-game catalog imports dated 2026-10-25; local preparation, not publication or installation
provenance: provenance.json (source, ownership, compatibility, blockers and validation; excluded from deployment ZIPs)

install.backup: Only affected existing files; original bytes preserved before mutation
install.tracking: Persistent per-install journal records original and installed hashes and created paths
install.failure: Selective rollback; retain recovery state on failure

uninstall.restore: Only files changed by the patch
uninstall.remove: Only patch-created files and empty patch-created directories
uninstall.preserve: Unrelated files, later saves and settings; detect post-install changes

requirements: Both Windows and macOS packages built
Native install/uninstall and gameplay validation recorded

validation_limits: Deterministic ZIP building does not compile or certify native executables.
Copy-only patches use portable data and Kitor native lifecycle; xdelta/BSDIFF packages require declared tools.
Synthetic roundtrips verify lifecycle behavior, not translation correctness or game build compatibility.
